reason: A DSH integration adapter for OneBot v11 that connects through HTTP or WebSocket, routes eligible messages into agent interactions, and sends text or image replies with configurable access controls.

summaries.zh: 通过 HTTP 或 WebSocket 连接 OneBot v11，将符合条件的消息接入 DSH Agent，并发送文本或图片回复。
summaries.en: Connects DSH to OneBot v11 over HTTP or WebSocket, routes eligible messages to DSH agents, and sends text or image replies.

capabilities: Connects to OneBot v11 through HTTP and forward or reverse WebSocket transports
Receives OneBot message, notice, request, and meta-event payloads
Creates DSH agent interactions from eligible message events
Sends text and image replies through OneBot
Accepts inbound webhook connections and applies access controls
Downloads permitted inbound images to DSH attachment storage
Uses referenced access tokens and webhook secrets
